items.title: With the exception of rookie Jayden Quaintance, the Spurs are healthy entering training camp.
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
With the exception of rookie Jayden Quaintance, the Spurs are healthy entering training camp.
 
"The plan for him is to get it (his knee) right and take it slow,” Mitch Johnson said of the 20th overall pick.
